name: Compute Cluster S35: Look-Ahead Lag Consistency
description: Tests: >> 1 lag on Donchian bands and ADX filter for look-ahead prevention, consistency rule (lag ALL components when ANY is lagged), breakout strategy with proper lag.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S35: Look-Ahead Lag Consistency
# Tests: lag all signals consistently, no mixing lagged and unlagged
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === DONCHIAN CHANNEL ===
donchian = donchian_channel(src.h, src.l, window=20)
upper = donchian.donchian_upper
lower = donchian.donchian_lower

# === ADX TREND FILTER ===
adx_val = adx(src.h, src.l, 14)

# === CORRECT: lag ALL components consistently ===
upper_prev = upper >> 1
lower_prev = lower >> 1
adx_prev = adx_val >> 1
trending = adx_prev > 25

# Breakout signals with ALL components lagged
long_sig = (close > upper_prev) and trending
short_sig = (close < lower_prev) and trending

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_sig, short_entry=short_sig)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=20)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=5)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Donchian Bands (lagged 1 bar)',
    category='Look-Ahead Guard',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Upper (prev)', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Lower (prev)', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, upper_prev, lower_prev))

xy_lines(
    title='ADX (lagged 1 bar)',
    category='Look-Ahead Guard',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ADX (prev)', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=adx_prev)
